cli riley-checkpoint --help.out:
riley-checkpoint (offline by default)
prepare --manifest PLAN.json --source REGULAR_DIRECTORY --destination NEW_DIRECTORY
verify --checkpoint DIRECTORY
download --manifest PLAN.json --destination NEW_DIRECTORY --allow-network [--token-env HF_TOKEN]
plan --repository OWNER/MODEL [--revision main] --output NEW_PLAN.json --allow-network [--token-env HF_TOKEN]
Download and plan require the separately compiled `hub` feature. Downloads accept only commits.
The manifest is an explicit file/size/SHA-256 allowlist; `plan` derives it from the Hub's
LFS SHA-256 and git blob ids at the commit the revision resolves to.
Never serve or edit a checkpoint until this command succeeds; verify after an interruption.
